title: Sprint close auto-report mutates before doctor gate passes
description: Evidence: sprint close --auto-report records sync evidence before running doctor; evidence attachment can change work to needs_verification, and a later doctor failure throws. Impact: failed close can leave the sprint partially mutated with evidence/status changes.
acceptanceCriteria: sprint close --auto-report runs blocking doctor gates before mutating evidence/status or records failure as an explicit reversible partial state, with a doctor-failure regression.
